Psychosis: Sometimes I hear voices, like whispers in the walls. They talk about me, saying things I don't understand.
I see things that aren't real. Bright lights seem like they're pulsing, and sometimes I think people are moving in slow motion.
People are out to get me. I know it, deep down, even when they're just talking normally. They're plotting something.
My thoughts jump around so fast. One minute I'm thinking about work, the next I'm wondering if the moon is made of cheese.
I feel like I'm not alone. There's this presence, watching me, but I can't see anyone there.
My hands shake uncontrollably, especially when I try to hold a cup steady. It's like they have a mind of their own.
I keep thinking the news is talking about me. I hear my name mentioned, even when I know it's not happening.
Sometimes I wake up thinking I've been somewhere else entirely. The bed is still here, but I feel like I'm remembering a different life.
I have to check mirrors constantly. I think my reflection is changing, like my face is melting or something.
I feel like everyone knows my secret, even though I've told no one. It's an invisible thing I'm hiding.
My mind feels foggy. It's hard to focus on conversations or read a book. Everything blends together.
I get overwhelmed by loud noises. The sound of traffic makes me want to hide, like it's attacking me.
I feel like I'm watching a movie, but the characters are me and my loved ones. Everything feels surreal.
I keep seeing shadows in the corners of my eyes. They don't move like normal people do.
I think the government is listening to my thoughts. Everything I think is broadcast somewhere.
My emotions shift without warning. One minute I'm laughing for no reason, the next I'm crying about nothing.
I feel like I'm moving in slow motion while everyone else is normal speed. Sometimes I can't move my legs at all.
I think my apartment is changing. Walls are different colors, or the furniture is rearranged when I come back.
I hear footsteps following me, even when I'm alone. Sometimes I turn around and there's nobody there.
I feel like I'm being watched on camera. People are filming me without their phones out.
I keep telling people that we need to leave immediately. Something bad is going to happen soon, but they don't understand.
I see small bugs crawling out of appliances. They're invisible to everyone else.
I feel like I'm drowning in water, even when I'm perfectly dry. The pressure is immense.
My sense of smell is off. I think the perfume someone is wearing smells like chemicals, not pleasant at all.
I keep apologizing for things I haven't done. People seem angry at me for reasons I can't grasp.
I feel like I'm invisible to most people. They don't see me unless I point it out.
I think I'm made of glass. If I bump into something, it might shatter.
I have to constantly check if I'm wearing the right clothes. Today I think I'm supposed to be a different color, but I don't know why.
I feel like time is speeding up or slowing down. Sometimes a minute feels like an hour, other times an hour feels like a minute.
I hear whispers in my head, telling me bad things are coming. I can't ignore them.
I see people with different faces than usual. Their features are melting or shifting.
I feel like I'm not real. Like I'm a character in someone else's story.
I think the food I eat tastes different. Sometimes it's metallic, other times it's like cardboard.
I feel like I'm surrounded by invisible walls. They're holding me in, trapping me.
I think I'm the only one who can see this. Everyone else is pretending not to notice the monsters under the bed.
I keep checking the news because I think it's about me. My name keeps popping up.
I feel like I'm leaking electricity. People can see the sparks.
I see flashes of light out of the corner of my eye. Sometimes they're so bright they hurt to look at.
I think I'm controlling the weather. Dark clouds gather whenever I look up.
I feel like I'm floating above my body. I watch myself move from a distance.
I hear my own thoughts spoken aloud, but no one is actually talking.
I feel like my skin is crawling with bugs. It's an unbearable sensation.
I think I'm allergic to everyone I know. Their touch makes me sick.
I keep repeating things in my head. 'It's coming, it's coming.'
I see crowds of people I know, but they're not the people I know. They're impostors.
I feel like I'm being pulled underwater. I can't breathe unless I fight against it.
I think my pets are communicating with me through telepathy. They tell me things I shouldn't know.
I feel like I'm in a giant maze. I keep getting lost, even though I've been here before.
I hear my name called, but no one is calling me. It's an echo.
I see things in the mirror that aren't there. A second mouth, or eyes glowing.
I feel like I'm suffocating. The air is thick and heavy.
I think I'm being followed by a shadow. It moves when I move, but it's never the same distance away.
I keep telling people I love them, but they don't remember saying it. I'm confusing their faces.
I feel like I'm running out of time. There's a clock ticking somewhere, but I can't find it.
I hear loud bangs in the distance, but they're actually footsteps.
I see people with butterfly wings. They fly around and disappear.
I feel like my memories are fake. I can't trust anything I remember.
I think I'm allergic to sunlight. It burns me even through clouds.
I keep checking my reflection because I think my eyes are changing color.
I feel like I'm in a submarine. The world outside is distorted and blurry.
I hear my own voice repeating what I say, but it's distorted.
I see things written in the air. Words float down like snowflakes.
I feel like I'm made of glass, so I can't touch anything without breaking.
I think I'm invisible to everyone except you. Only you can see me.
I hear music playing that no one else can hear. It's usually discordant.
I see people with too many fingers. Or sometimes too few.
I feel like I'm underwater, and the water is very cold.
I think I'm the most important person in the world. Everyone should bow to me.
I keep apologizing for things I haven't done. It's like I'm always in the wrong.
I feel like I'm being watched by a giant eye in the sky.
I see people with holes in their bodies. The holes aren't bleeding, though.
I think I'm allergic to human contact. Touching anyone makes me sick.
I hear footsteps behind me, but when I turn around, there's nobody there.
I see my reflection, but it's not me. It's someone else wearing my face.
I feel like I'm made of ice. I'm melting slowly.
I think I'm controlling the minds of others through my thoughts.
I keep telling people I'm fine, but I'm not. Everything feels wrong.
I see crowds of people I know, but they're all wearing masks.
I feel like I'm on fire, but I can't feel the heat.
I hear whispers in the wind, telling me secrets I shouldn't know.
I see things that happened in the past repeating in the present.
I feel like I'm falling through space. There's no ground below me.
I think I'm a superhero in disguise. I just haven't realized my powers yet.
I keep checking the time because I think the world is ending soon.
I see animals walking upright, talking, and going about their day.
I feel like my thoughts are being broadcast on a radio station.
I hear my own heartbeat, but it sounds like a drum.
I see people with tentacles growing out of their heads.
I feel like I'm in a dream, and I'm going to wake up soon.
I think I'm allergic to happiness. Everything I touch turns sour.
I keep repeating the same questions over and over. 'Why? Why?'
